apps.name: Traffic Escape: Car Puzzle
apps.blurb: Stuck in traffic? You're the one who gets to fix it.
apps.description:
Stuck in traffic? You're the one who gets to fix it.

Traffic Escape: Car Puzzle is a relaxing, family-friendly sliding puzzle — completely free to play, with no account, no sign-up, and nothing to buy to enjoy the full game.

Every level is a tightly packed grid of cars, trucks, and buses. Slide them out of each other's way, one smart move at a time, until every vehicle escapes the board. No timers, no pressure — just you, the grid, and the satisfaction of a perfectly cleared jam.

SAFE FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY

• No account or personal information required to play, ever
• Ads shown are always non-personalized — we don't track you or your kids
• Simple, gentle gameplay with no violence, no chat, and nothing scary
• Your progress is saved privately, right on your own device

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag any vehicle forward or backward along its lane
• Vehicles can only move in a straight line — plan your order carefully
• Clear the board in as few moves as possible to earn up to 3 stars

410 FREE LEVELS, 12 CITIES
Drive through Downtown, Harbor Side, Neon Night, Desert Highway, Mountain Pass, and Sky Metro... — each with its own look and rising difficulty, from simple warmups to satisfying multi-step challenges. All 410 levels are unlocked through play — nothing is ever paywalled.

STUCK? NO PROBLEM
• Undo your last move if you change your mind
• Use a free Hint when you're really stuck

COLLECT & CUSTOMIZE
Earn coins just by playing, then spend them on new car liveries — including special Ambulance, Police, and Taxi skins.

COME BACK DAILY
Come back each day for a free, growing coin streak.

Whether you've got 2 minutes or 20, Traffic Escape: Car Puzzle is the perfect free, family-safe puzzle for clearing your head — and clearing the road.

apps.name: BloomSort: Pour & Decorate
apps.blurb: Pour, sort and decorate — 180 levels, daily challenges, and a room that grows with you.
apps.description:
Welcome to Bloom Sort! Pour, sort, and decorate your way through 12 cozy chapters — 180 levels, Daily Challenges, and a room to call your own.

Pour, sort, and unwind! Bloom Sort is a cozy color-sorting puzzle where every level you solve helps decorate a brand new room. Simple to learn, endlessly satisfying, and completely free to play.

HOW TO PLAY
Tap a tube to pick it up, then tap another to pour. Match same-colored liquid together until every tube holds just one color. That's it — pure, relaxing puzzle logic with a satisfying pour animation on every move.

DECORATE AS YOU GO
Every level you win unlocks a new piece of furniture for that chapter's room. Clear all 15 levels in a chapter and watch an empty space become a fully decorated little world — then move on to the next themed room.

FEATURES
• 180 handcrafted levels across 12 beautifully themed chapters
• A real pour animation — watch liquid slosh and flow between tubes
• Unlock and decorate a unique room for every chapter
• Daily Challenge with its own streak to keep
• Earn coins and up to 3 stars per level
• Undo and Hint to help you out of a tricky spot
• No sign-up, no internet required to play — your progress is saved right on your device
• Relaxing pastel art style, easy on the eyes for a quick break anytime

Bloom Sort is designed for everyone, including kids — every ad shown is non-personalized, and we never ask for tracking permission.

Pour a little, sort a little, decorate a little. Download Bloom Sort and start your first room today.

apps.name: ScrollPause: Stop the Scroll
apps.blurb: One moment of friction between you and the app you opened without meaning to.
apps.description:
ScrollPause puts one moment of friction between you and the app you open without meaning to.

Pick the apps that pull you in. The next time you open one, a pause screen appears first. It tells you which app you are opening and what time it is, and asks whether you really meant to. Tap "I'll pass" and the app closes. Tap through twice and you get five minutes, then the pause comes back.

That is the whole idea. No streaks, no lectures, no shame.

LOCK SCROLLPAUSE ITSELF WITH A PIN
Every screen-time tool has the same weak point: the moment you decide to switch it off. Usually that moment arrives late at night, and it wins.

Set a four-digit PIN and ScrollPause asks for it before it opens. Your quiet hours, your paused apps, your settings — none of it can be changed by whoever is holding the phone. Including you, at 1am.

• The PIN is asked when the app opens, and again after thirty seconds away
• Five wrong tries and the waiting starts: thirty seconds, then five minutes, then fifteen, then an hour
• Moving the phone's clock forward does not shorten that wait
• The app switcher preview is covered, so a glance at your phone shows nothing
• Forgot it? A twelve-character recovery code, saved when you set the PIN and readable again from Settings whenever you want

What the PIN honestly does and does not do: it guards ScrollPause. It cannot stop anyone from deleting the app, or from switching Screen Time off in iPhone Settings — no app on iOS can do that, and any app that says otherwise is selling you something.

WHAT ELSE YOU GET
• A pause screen in front of the apps you choose, drawn by iOS itself
• Two taps to get in, so going in is a decision rather than a reflex
• A count of how often you paused and how often you walked away
• A weekly summary in plain words: when you reach for your phone most, which day was hardest, how you compare to last week
• A home-screen widget with the minutes you kept today

SCROLLPAUSE PRO
• Lock the app with a PIN
• Pause up to 50 apps instead of 3
• Quiet hours: the hours where there is no five-minute pass at all
• Every past week, not just this one

Pro is a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase. There is no free trial that renews behind your back.

NOTHING LEAVES YOUR PHONE
No account. No sign-in. No server. No ads. No analytics. No third-party code of any kind.

The apps you choose are handled by Apple's Screen Time system, which hands ScrollPause an anonymous token for each one — a value the app cannot read or turn back into a name. Your counts live in a database on your iPhone. Your PIN is stored as a one-way hash in the iOS Keychain and never leaves the device. Delete the app and all of it goes with it.

Made by PrimeTruth Team. Questions: zenDesign219@gmail.com

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://primetruthteam.github.io/scrollpause/privacy/

apps.name: TenSweep: Sum to 10 Puzzle
apps.blurb: Swipe, add up to 10, and sweep the board clean.
apps.description:
Swipe, add up to 10, and sweep the board clean!

TenSweep is a fast, friendly number puzzle built around one simple rule: swipe across neighboring tiles that add up to exactly 10 to clear them. Easy to learn in seconds, hard to put down. No account, no sign-up, and no in-app purchases — the whole game is yours from the first swipe.

HOW TO PLAY
• Swipe across two or more adjacent tiles whose numbers add up to exactly 10: 6+4, 2+3+5, 1+2+3+4…
• Cleared tiles vanish and new ones drop in, so the board keeps flowing
• Longer chains score more, and back-to-back clears build a combo multiplier
• Reach a x5 combo to set off a MEGA COMBO celebration
• Out of moves? The board reshuffles itself, so you can never get stuck

JOURNEY: 240 LEVELS, 12 CHAPTERS
Ride along with a little delivery truck hauling numbered crates from the Neighborhood through Downtown, Harbor, Airport, Highway, Mountain Pass, Night Town, Train Depot and beyond, all the way to the Final Stop. Every level gives you a limited number of moves and its own goal: reach a target score, clear a set number of a specific digit, or build long chains. Finish with moves to spare to earn up to 3 stars. Boards start at a cozy 5×5 grid and grow to 8×8 as the route gets tougher.

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
• Time Attack: 75 seconds to score as high as you can
• Zen: no timer, no move limit, play until you feel like stopping
• Daily Challenge: the same board for every player, once a day. Can you top the leaderboard?

COMPETE & SHARE
• Game Center leaderboards for High Score, Daily Challenge and Total Stars
• 13 achievements to unlock as you complete chapters and land big combos
• Share your score or level result with one tap

FEATURES
• 240 levels with a carefully tuned difficulty curve
• Interactive tutorial that teaches the game in under a minute
• Colorblind-safe mode with distinct tile patterns and borders
• Music, sound effects and vibration you can toggle anytime
• Play in English or Vietnamese, switch instantly in Settings
• Progress is saved right on your device, no internet needed to play
• Quick sessions: a Time Attack run takes just over a minute

SAFE FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
• No account or personal information required to play, ever
• Ads are always non-personalized, and we never ask for tracking permission
• Optional reward ads for a few extra moves or seconds, never required to progress
• Gentle gameplay with no violence, no chat and nothing scary

Whether you've got 2 minutes or 20, TenSweep is the perfect brain-tickling break. Swipe, sum, sweep, and see how far the truck can go.
